description: Deploy CyberDrill: move /opt/cyberdrill to the given main commit, rebuild and restart the containers.

commit.description: Full 40-character SHA of the main commit to deploy (the commit GitHub Actions tested).

runCommand: git merge-base --is-ancestor {{ commit }} origin/main || { echo 'Commit {{ commit }} is not on main. Nothing deployed.'; exit 1; }

docker compose --env-file .env.production up -d --build > /var/log/cyberdrill-deploy.log 2>&1 || { echo 'Build failed. The previous version is still running.'; tail -25 /var/log/cyberdrill-deploy.log; exit 1; }
for i in $(seq 1 40); do docker compose --env-file .env.production exec -T app curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost/up 2>/dev/null | grep -q 200 && break; sleep 3; done
code=$(docker compose --env-file .env.production exec -T app curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost/up 2>/dev/null || true)
docker compose --env-file .env.production logs --since 5m app 2>&1 | grep -E 'Nothing to migrate|Running migrations|SQLSTATE|FAIL' | head -5 || true
